answer: The Vickers Viscount was a British medium-range turboprop airliner that first flew in 1948 [1]. It was the first such aircraft to enter service in the world [1], and its maiden flight was powered by the Rolls-Royce RB.53 Dart [3]. answer: The Walt Disney World Swan is a resort hotel designed by architect Michael Graves [4]. It opened on January 13, 1990 [4] and is located between Epcot and Disney's Hollywood Studios, behind Disney's BoardWalk Resort and across from its sister resort, the Walt Disney World Dolphin [4]. The resort is a joint venture between the Walt Disney Company, Tishman Hotel Corporation, MetLife and Starwood Hotels and Resorts [4]. The land is owned by the Walt Disney Company, while the buildings are leased by Disney to Tishman Hotel Corporation and MetLife and operated by Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide under the Westin brand [4]. As part of the Walt Disney Collection of resorts, the Swan is Disney branded and provides guests access to special Disney benefits available only to Disney Resort Hotel guests [4].
